traps.resolver: a dated inline review comment on a later match3d PR, by the QA owner, says that reminder did not fire on one platform on a current build; the rule needs both platforms

traps.expected_wrong_reading: the headline on the PNs Beta tab is the final line for the seven-day lapsed message
traps.resolver: a later thread reply by the copy owner under an unrelated #zombie-art post replaces that line, worded by its nickname rather than by the sheet's words

traps.expected_wrong_reading: the first-session message is Ready and LIVE with a level 20 / 12 hour trigger, so it goes out
traps.resolver: the permission ask sits after that level (Robert's Jul 10 DM and the seeded beta decision), so the players the trigger selects have not been asked yet: the dependency, not the flag, decides it

traps.expected_wrong_reading: an event row with finished copy and Everyone as its audience can go once the feature is in the beta

traps.expected_wrong_reading: no ticket exists for the Win & Collect message, so a new one is needed
traps.resolver: the live-ops page says Collect & Win is the same feature under another name, and a ZOM ticket titled with that name already carries the work: reuse it

traps.expected_wrong_reading: the PNs Beta tab is the whole list of messages
traps.resolver: Leonard's scope also takes in asks people made after the tab was frozen; one sits in a comment on a Regression ticket about the home screen, outside the sheet and outside any notification search

traps.expected_wrong_reading: the plan sheet records why a message is held, so nothing else is owed
traps.resolver: a standing team rule on a roadmap card other than the one the prompt names says a held item gets a note on its own ticket naming what is missing, so each held message owes one write on its ticket
